Hi! Let us solve this together. 

Look at the bottom numbers, the denominators. 
We have a 3 and a 6. 

How do we change 3 into 6? 
What number do we multiply by?
Multiply by 2. So 2/3 is 4/6 because we do top times 2 also. next: 2/9 + 4/9?

Great job on that last part! 

Now we have two fractions. 
They are 2 over 9 and 4 over 9. 

Look at the bottom numbers. 
Are they the same?
is it 6/18? I am not sure.

That is a good guess. But wait! 

When the bottom numbers are the same, we leave them alone. 

We only add the top numbers together. 

What is 2 plus 4?
is 6/9 because bottom stay same and 2 plus 4 is 6 next: 1/4 + 1/8?

Spot on! You got it right. 

Now we have 1 over 4 plus 1 over 8. 

Look at the bottom numbers. 
Are they the same?
No, bottom number is not same. I think answer is 2/12 maybe?

Not quite. We cannot add them yet. 

We need to make the bottom numbers match first. 

Can you change the 4 into an 8? 

What do you multiply 4 by to get 8?
